# `pointer-only-free`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports reconstructing a fixed-length slice from a many pointer and passing it
to an allocator's `free` without receiving the allocation length.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Allocator release contracts require the original allocation layout; a guessed
length can corrupt allocator state or fail safety checks.

## When it fires

Preserve the original slice or pass the exact allocation length across the
boundary.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn release(allocator: std.mem.Allocator, ptr: [*]u8) void {
    const bytes = ptr[0..16];
    allocator.free(bytes);
}
```
